verdicts.typography: Flawless typographic hierarchy. The heading scale from the large 'Monitoring dashboard' down through section headers to the mono uppercase micro-labels (e.g., 'DATA AS OF 2026-08-31', 'TOP 5 RISK ZONES') is perfectly rhythmic. Weight contrast between bold headings and regular body text is crisp. Mono labels are disciplined, consistently uppercase with appropriate tracking. No orphans, no cramped text, and line-heights are generous throughout all views including the dense analytics table.
verdicts.color: Strictly one restrained red accent (#C53030 or equivalent) applied consistently across live status indicators, active nav underlines, KPI emphasis numbers ('227'), severity badges ('CRITICAL', 'ELEVATED'), risk bars, map choropleth fills, and the hero accent word 'this?'. All neutrals are clean near-black on white. WCAG AA contrast is clearly met. No visual noise, no competing colors, no gradients except the functional matrix shadow noted in context.
verdicts.layout: Publication-grade Swiss grid alignment. All content respects a consistent max-width container with generous whitespace rhythm. Hairline borders form intact grids—the KPI strip, risk zone list, analytics projection table, architecture cards, and footer row all show perfect cell alignment with no double borders or misaligned joints. The footer sits cleanly at the document bottom with proper left/right padding balance. The side detail panel in the Risk Map view maintains correct vertical rhythm against the map canvas.
verdicts.components: All component systems—matrix tables with sticky columns and red-accented final column, tab bars with clear active states, KPI strips, the Kenya choropleth map with legend, Venn diagrams with region counts, vehicle sighting timelines with dots and window bands, alert cards with severity chips, and data tables with sticky headers and right-aligned numerals—are rendered correctly at normal viewing distance. No visible breakage, misalignment, overlap, or illegibility is present in any of the provided screenshots.
verdicts.responsive: Flawless mobile and dark-mode execution. Mobile 390px layouts show correct stacking, readable type, no horizontal overflow, and proper scaling for KPIs, maps, and tables. Dark-mode palette is consistent with high contrast across all components.
